author: PirateINDUSTRY
body:
Berserk 1 (atk/mag ↑) = Berserker Skill  |  Berserk 2 (All ↑)= Mushroom, Berserker Skill  |  Berserk 3 (All ↑↑) = Raider Skill

Berserk 2 & 3 raise all base stats by 25% (↑) and 50% (↑↑)

Each level has a more difficult DoT.  You cannot remove this DoT.  However, this can mean increased dodge and cancelling enemy damage.
